SMTO-LEG-0001 — The license agreement changed while you were reviewing it

GUID: 736db593-e713-4106-8c5a-f86312247390
Slug: eula-document-changed
Domain: LEG · Subsystem: leg

What happened

  • You tried to accept a version of the license agreement that is no longer the current one, so your acceptance wasn't recorded. SMTO reloads the current version for you to review.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Read the agreement now shown in the window; it has been reloaded with the current version. Your acceptance must match the exact version SMTO requires right now.
  2. If you agree, tick the I have read and agree box again and select I Agree & Continue. The box was cleared so you can't accept a version you haven't seen.
  3. If the same message appears again, reload the page, open Settings, go to Licenses and legal, and select Accept current version. Reloading makes sure the page shows the agreement the server has after an update.

What success looks like

  • The agreement window closes, and Settings › Licenses and legal shows the same Accepted version as the Current version.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who installed or manages SMTO; the server may have been updated while you were reading. Don't keep resubmitting from an old page.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The EULA accept request's version or document_sha256 does not match the current agreement (neither its canonical nor its displayed hash), so no acceptance was stored.

What this means

  • Acceptance compares the submitted version/hash with the current agreement and rejects a version mismatch or a hash matching neither accepted canonical nor displayed content. These are product document-identity and admission checks. Diagnostics neither accept terms for a user nor change agreement/acceptance records; publisher defects require publisher repair.

Why this can happen

  • Acceptance compares the submitted version/hash with the current agreement and rejects a version mismatch or a hash matching neither accepted canonical nor displayed content.

How to diagnose it

  • Open the current agreement and compare its version/document identity with the reviewed submission.

How to fix it

  • POST /api/legal/eula/accept returned 409 eula_document_changed from EulaService.accept in src/agent_runtime/legal/service.py. Refetch GET /api/legal/eula and submit its version and document_sha256; a client that keeps sending a stale hash needs a reload after a server upgrade.
  • Open and review the current document and accept it if intended.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Any voluntary acceptance identifies the exact current reviewed document.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • These are product document-identity and admission checks. Diagnostics neither accept terms for a user nor change agreement/acceptance records; publisher defects require publisher repair.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
